description: Accounts receivable aging (limit is accepted and ignored; totals include every open invoice): every open invoice's balance by how late it is (current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, over 90 days past due), with totals per customer (owner or office); an invoice with no due date is due when sent.

limit.description: Accepted and ignored. Aging has no page. Totals include every open invoice. List ops default to 50 rows when limit is left out.
